days.headline: ★ Board the train to Churchill — overnight
days.heads: Get the rig ready to be left in Thompson for 5 days — 2 gal RV antifreeze in the drains, water lines drained & blown out, hot water tank drained, electric heater left on the counter (no antifreeze in fresh water lines). A co-leader assists; keys stay with Colleen at McCreedy. Train baggage: carry-on 1 personal item (25 lb) + 1 item (50 lb / 62 linear in), checked 2 × 50 lb. No dining car (snack/lounge car only, very limited, no dietary accommodation) — bring your own; alcohol must be checked, not carry-on. Security screening in Thompson. No sleeper? Bring a pillow and blanket. Camping fees, taxi to the station, and all Churchill gratuities are in the kitty fee.
